s_70a0b3af2b: Early math gaps are hard to see in a class of 25. MathLift is a K, 2 solar-system practice app that watches how a student builds a number, taps, retries, written digits, and tells the teacher which misconception to practice next. Inference runs on the device. Drawings and tap traces are not uploaded.
s_e98ba247b9: A first grader who always recounts from one, or who subtracts the smaller number from the larger, can still look “fine” on a weekly worksheet. By the time that shows up on a test, the habit is set. Teachers rarely have time to diagnose each child’s strategy in the moment.

howModel: Overshoot, restarting from one, reversed digits, and swapped equation order are features for an on-device decision tree. Written numbers are read by a small local model.
howPractice: Six short problems are made on this device from that pattern, with different numbers each time. If one is missed, the next one can tighten. This is not a chatbot.
loginWelcome: Welcome back. Enter the same class code and space name you used when you joined. It works on any device. Ask your teacher if you forget the name. They can see it on the class roster.
joinLead: Enter your teacher's class code. We'll give you a fun space name. Remember it, or write it down, so you can come back on any phone, tablet, or computer.
joinDice: Don't like it? Tap the dice for a new one, as many times as you want. We use fun names, not real names.
firebaseStores: stores class codes, generated student usernames, and progress. Google's processing is limited to hosting this database. We do not
supportBody: MathLift is a K, 2 classroom app for counting, addition, and subtraction. Teachers create a class. Students join with a generated space name. After practice, the teacher dashboard shows a thinking summary and a short briefing. Drawings stay on the device.
removeFailed: Could not remove {{name}}. They may already be gone. Refresh and try again.
sampleFor: Sample practice for {{name}}. This is not a live student.
demoRoundNote: Six short problems, built on this device from how this student worked. Each new round uses different numbers.
liveRoundNote: Six short problems. Start when you are ready.
joNeedsPie: Jo needs {{count}} apples for a pie.
joNeedsSpeak: Jo needs {{count}} apples for a pie. Can you put the right amount?
teach_sun: Say one number for each thing you see. The last number is how many.
teach_mercury: The story tells you how many. Put in that many, then stop.
teach_venus: Listen to the story, then count only what it asks for.
teach_earth: Keep the pencils you have, then add the new ones on the end.
teach_mars: 2 plus 5 and 5 plus 2 are the same total.
teach_jupiter: A ten and some ones together are one number.
teach_saturn: Start with the whole group, then take some away.
teach_uranus: Take away the number the story says, not the other one.
teach_neptune: The number you take away is the one the story asks for.
solo_lead: No class code, email, or password. Pick a space name, optionally set a PIN, and learn on this device.
solo_privacy: Progress stays on this device only (and is mirrored in the iOS Keychain on iPhone). Nothing is sent to the cloud in individual mode.
solo_foundProgress: We found solo progress for {{name}} on this device.
solo_needName: Roll a space name to continue.
solo_missingProgress: No solo progress found on this device.
solo_skipCheck: Skip check — start at the Sun
solo_pinOptional: Add a 4-digit PIN to reopen this progress on this device. You can leave this off.
solo_pinInvalid: Enter exactly four digits, or turn the PIN off.
place_lead: A short, gentle check helps us suggest a starting planet. There is no timer and no score.
place_q_count: How many dots do you see?
place_skip: Skip and start at the Sun
place_exploreFree: You can still explore other open planets anytime.
place_pickPlanet: Pick any planet to begin. You can change later by exploring.
place_unlockedThrough: Planets are open through {{planet}}. Finish a lesson to open the next one.
place_score: You got {{correct}} of {{total}} on the check.
place_sum_sun: We will begin with counting at the Sun.
place_sum_count: Counting looks ready. We suggest an early counting planet.
place_sum_add: Counting and adding look ready. We suggest an early addition planet.
place_sum_sub: Take-away looks ready. We suggest an early subtraction planet.
place_sum_place: Tens and ones look ready. We suggest Jupiter for place value.
place_sum_skip: No check this time. Begin at the Sun and unlock planets as you finish lessons.
hub_unlock_solo: Planets are open through {{planet}}. Tap a planet to start its lesson.
hub_unlock_class: Your teacher has unlocked planets through {{planet}}. Tap a planet to start its lesson.
hub_continue_tap: Tap {{planet}} to continue where you left off.
hub_pick_solo_new: Pick any open planet to begin. Finish a lesson to open the next world.
hub_pick_solo_return: Replay earlier planets or jump ahead to any planet you have opened.
hub_pick_class_new: Pick any unlocked planet to begin. Your teacher can open more planets anytime.
hub_pick_class_return: Replay earlier planets or jump ahead to any planet your teacher has unlocked.
planetLevel_lead: Planet levels are the solar-system path from counting to addition to subtraction.
planetLevel_how: The starting planet unlocks every world up to that planet. Students can replay earlier planets. Raising it updates the roster live so you see where each student currently is.
planetLevel_band_count_help: One-to-one counting, exact totals, and story counting (numbers to about 12).
planetLevel_band_add_help: Adding within 12–20, then tens and ones up to 100 on Jupiter.
planetLevel_band_sub_help: Take-away within 12–20 and keeping the whole group first.
planetLevel_rosterHint: Shows furthest progress, or the class start if they have not moved past it yet.
planetLevel_whatBody: Each planet is a topic with a number range and one example skill. Ranges match what lessons and drills actually practice.
planetLevel_usePlacement: Use placement check for new students
planetLevel_usePlacementHelp: Optional. When on, new joiners take a short placement check before starting. Existing students are unchanged.
planetLevel_placementSaveFail: Could not save the placement setting. Try again.
planetLevel_printPlacementOn: Placement check on for new students

pl_skill_saturn: take away from a whole group
